title: 第七百九十四章 双剑逆天 蝶影镇岳第七百九十三章 蝶刃惊风 傲骨凌天
content_zh:
魔鱼、黑蝠二位长老感知到花宗主这股可怖威势，不敢硬抗。
齐齐脚下点地，纵身后跃数丈，凝神戒备。
而立于对面的虫小蝶与沈惊鸿，瞬间被这股盖世威压牢牢笼罩！
无形重力沉沉压落周身，仿佛万钧山岳覆顶。
四肢百骸皆被禁锢，气血滞涩、呼吸沉缓，头皮阵阵发麻！
周遭空气浓稠如铁，每一寸空间都充斥着霸烈森寒的气息。
让人几乎难以抬首、难以动弹。
二人衣发被劲风死死压坠，眉眼沉沉凝起。
全身神经尽数紧绷，直面这挤垮天地的绝顶威压！
花百漾周身隐隐流转赤红真气，霸道内敛、深藏不露。
数十年苦修的异蝶术尽数敛于体内。
看似身姿平和、静立不动，实则暗藏吞纳天地、碾压万物的无上霸势！
他屹立武林巅峰数十载，俯瞰天下群雄。
从未有何人能逼得他展露全力。
即便眼前虫小蝶身怀绝世蝶刃剑法、沈惊鸿剑道底蕴超群。
在他眼中，依旧只是两个不值一提的后生晚辈！
纵使滔天威压临身、山岳压顶，虫小蝶与沈惊鸿眼底依旧未曾有半分惧色！
二人澄澈的眼眸之中，熊熊燃着滚烫炽热的剑道狂火！
长剑在手，胸中藏锋。
一身剑道修为沉淀厚重、凛冽孤绝、不染凡尘，早已超脱世俗武境桎梏！

虚无化蝶，刃风千里！
以心铸剑，焚身证道！
今日强敌当前、绝境对峙。
二人心意相通、剑道共鸣！
双剑齐鸣共振，两道澄澈刺眼的湛蓝色剑芒同时自剑身炸裂而起，交相辉映、照亮暗夜！
二人以剑明心，以证此生无上剑道！
欲凭手中三尺之刃，逆伐天下至尊！
“花百漾！”
虫小蝶清冷沉肃的声音骤然破开漫天风声与死寂。
声音不算洪亮，却字字贯耳、震彻心神，压过世间一切喧嚣！
“你霸踞中原武林数十载。纵容邪道、残害正道门派，杀伐无忌、罪孽滔天。
content_en:
The two elders, Demon Fish and Black Bat, sensed the terrifying power of Sect Master Hua and did not dare to resist.
They all touched the ground with their feet, jumped several feet behind them, and concentrated on alert.
Chong Xiaodie and Shen Jinghong, who were standing opposite, were instantly enveloped by this unparalleled pressure!
Invisible gravity weighed heavily on the whole body, as if the top of a mountain were covered with mountains.
All the limbs and bones were imprisoned, Qi and blood were stagnant, breathing was slow, and the scalp was numb!
The air around him was as thick as iron, and every inch of space was filled with the aura of tyrannical coldness.
It is almost difficult to lift one's head and move.
The clothes and hair of the two men were weighed down by the strong wind, and their eyebrows were condensed.
All the nerves in the body were tense, facing the overwhelming pressure that overwhelmed the world!
Hua Baiyang's whole body was faintly filled with crimson energy, which was domineering, restrained, and hidden.
All the exotic butterfly skills that he had practiced hard for decades were trapped in his body.
His figure appears to be peaceful and motionless, but in fact it hides the supreme power that swallows up the world and crushes all things!
He has stood at the pinnacle of the martial arts world for decades, overlooking all the heroes in the world.
No one has ever been able to force him to show his full strength.
Even though the immediate insect Xiaodie possesses peerless butterfly blade swordsmanship, Shen Jinghong has excellent swordsmanship.
In his eyes, they are still just two juniors who are not worth mentioning!
Even though the overwhelming pressure was upon them and the mountains were overwhelming, there was still no trace of fear in the eyes of Chong Xiaodie and Shen Jinghong!
In the clear eyes of the two men, there was a blazing hot kendo fire!
The long sword is in the hand, and the edge is hidden in the chest.
His swordsmanship is profound, fierce and solitary, untainted by the worldly world, and he has already transcended the shackles of the worldly martial arts!
Nothingness turns into a butterfly, and the blade winds thousands of miles!
Forge a sword with your heart and burn your body to prove the Tao!
Today, we are facing a powerful enemy and facing a desperate situation.
The two have the same mind and the same swordsmanship!
The two swords resonated in unison, and two clear and dazzling blue sword lights exploded from the sword body at the same time, reflecting each other and illuminating the dark night!
The two use their swords to clarify their hearts and prove the supreme swordsmanship in this life!
I want to use the three-foot blade in my hand to defeat the world's supreme king!
"Hua Baiyang!"
Chong Xiaodie's cold and solemn voice suddenly broke through the wind and dead silence in the sky.
The voice is not loud, but every word hits the ears and shakes the mind, overwhelming all the noise in the world!
"You have dominated the martial arts world in the Central Plains for decades. You have indulged in evil ways, harmed righteous sects, killed without restraint, and committed heinous crimes.
